chunks: We have not given any man everlastingness before you. So if you die, will they live ever after?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the mortality of prophets and the concept of eternal life for humans?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the humanity of the Prophet as a necessary condition for his role as a relatable guide, distinguishing his mortal nature from the divine essence of the Imams who possess a unique, though not absolute, form of eternal life through divine grace. It refutes the polytheists' demand for miraculous immortality, affirming that death is a universal decree for all humans, thereby validating the continuity of prophethood after Muhammad's passing. This concept reinforces the Shia belief in the succession of leadership, where the spiritual authority continues even after the physical death of the Prophet.
